title: The Barbecue — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish French language learning Perth Australia barbecue
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The barbecue is a democratic institution in Western Australia
Where everyone stands near the heat and offers up their failure
To resist the urge to turn the meat before it's ready
The barbecue requires patience and a hand both firm and steady

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El asado es una institución democrática en Australia Occidental
[The barbecue is a democratic institution in Western Australia]
Donde todos se paran cerca del calor — es universal
[Where everyone stands near the heat — it is universal]
Nadie puede resistir el impulso de dar vuelta la carne
[Nobody can resist the urge to turn the meat]
El asado requiere paciencia y mano firme que no arde
[The barbecue requires patience and a firm hand that doesn't burn]

[Chorus — English]
The barbecue knows something I don't know
It knows the exact temperature of showing off the full show
The barbecue is where the men stand and discuss what's on the grill
And nobody moves from their position with sufficient skill
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le barbecue est une institution démocratique à Perth
[The barbecue is a democratic institution in Perth]
Tout le monde se tient près de la chaleur — c'est la loi de la terre
[Everyone stands near the heat — it is the law of the land]
Personne ne peut résister l'envie de retourner la viande
[Nobody can resist the urge to turn the meat]
Le barbecue est une philosophie — c'est la commande
[The barbecue is a philosophy — it is the order]

[Outro — All three languages]
The barbecue knows… El asado sabe… Le barbecue sait
Patience before the turn — Paciencia antes de dar vuelta — Patience avant de retourner
That's my boy
